items.headline: OpenAI adds ChatGPT Wallet for card-free payments
items.summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, letting users store a debit or credit card for payments without re-entering card information. The feature deepens ChatGPT's push into commerce and agentic transactions.

items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model
items.summary: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers, enterprises, and consumers, touting state-of-the-art cybersecurity and improved agentic coding. The launch came just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon as Google intensifies competition with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.headline: Anthropic launches its own AI-powered office suite
items.summary: Anthropic rolled out an AI-powered office suite, following Google and OpenAI into integrated productivity tools. The move puts Claude in direct competition with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace for enterprise work.

items.headline: Anthropic unveils Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models
items.summary: Anthropic released two new frontier models — Fable 5.2 for coding and agents, Mythos 5.2 for restricted cybersecurity and life-sciences work — generating outputs up to 30% faster at lower prices. It's the company's first frontier release since CEO Dario Amodei called to slow the pace of AI development in September.

items.headline: xAI enables default watermarking on Grok text outputs
items.summary: Starting November 7, xAI turned on watermarking by default for text outputs across its Grok model lineup, including grok-4.7, with per-model opt-out available. The move addresses provenance and authenticity concerns across its APIs.

items.headline: Cohere brings Embed 5 and Rerank 5 to OpenRouter
items.summary: Cohere made its Embed 5 and Rerank 5 models available on OpenRouter, broadening access to its retrieval and ranking tools. The release targets developers building RAG and search applications.
